ios.desc:
We are a podcast player where you can listen to all your podcasts ad-free with no fees. We automatically skip all commercials, including the ones the hosts read out. You can now enjoy the content you love with no interruptions.

Key features:
- Automatically skip all commercials
- Offline listening
- Organize your episodes with bookmarks and queue filters
- Add your private podcast feeds
- 24/7 live support

quotes.text:
Alora Podcasts lets you listen ad-free to all your podcasts, including host-read ads. Here’s why we created it.

There was a time when listening to podcasts felt personal. No annoying breaks and no shouting “we’ll be right back.” Somewhere along the way, your experience was compromised. Stories get chopped up by ads and moments of flow get replaced by friction. But it wasn't always like this. The medium lost respect for your time and attention.

We created this to make listening feel personal again. To do that, we developed a system that detects and cuts ads out of the audio before you ever hit play. Repetitive sponsor reads, irrelevant products, and time-consuming promos. All gone.

It took 18 months of trial and error, dead ends, and a lot of frustration. We rebuilt our audio infrastructure over and over again, reworked transcript systems that weren’t accurate enough, and fixed tiny transitions that lasted less than a blink but still ruined the moment. We spent many nights replaying the same two seconds of audio on loop, chasing a cut you’d never notice but that we couldn’t ignore.

And then came the time an episode finally played straight through with no interruptions. In that moment, it felt like we’d restored something sacred the medium had forgotten. It felt amazing. The best technology doesn’t add more. It takes away what doesn’t belong.

But this isn’t just for listeners, it’s for podcast creators too. Our mission is not to take from podcasts, it is to grow them. We …
